async function a(items: string[], op: (item: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit<string>(items, op, { concurrency: 1 });
}
async function b(items: string[], op: (item: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit<string>(items, { concurrency: 1 }, op);
}
async function c(items: string[], op: (item: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit<string>({ concurrency: 1 }, items, op);
}
async function d(items: string[], op: (item: string) => Promise<void>) {
	mapLimit<string>(items, op, { concurrency: 1 });
}
async function e(items: string[], op: (item: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await lib.mapLimit<string>(items, op, { limit: 1 });
}
async function f(items: string[], op: (item: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit<string>(items, 1, op);
}
async function g(items: string[], op: (item: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit<string, void>(items, op, { width: 1 });
}
